title: Real polynomial representing a real part
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $P$ be a polynomial in $n$ variables with complex coefficients. There is a polynomial $Q$ in $n$ variables with real coefficients such that, for every $x\in\mathbb R^n$, $Q(x)$ equals the real part of $P(x)$, where $P$ is evaluated using the complex coordinates of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a polynomial in $n$ variables with complex coefficients
